briefdescription.para: GBComputation subclass that drives an F4GB engine instance from the engine-side computation API.

detaileddescription.para: Owns the F4GB, the source PolynomialRing, the FreeModule the GB lives in, and the optional RingElement* Hilbert function used for early termination. Implements start_computation / stop_conditions_ok / complete_thru_degree by delegating to F4GB's degree-by-degree driver, and exposes the standard get_matrix / get_gb / get_change / get_syzygies accessors the front end polls when done.
